title: How to Troubleshoot High-Resolution PACS DICOM Viewing
content:
ARTICLE: How to Troubleshoot High-Resolution PACS DICOM Viewing (KA-019)
SYSTEM: PACS Viewer
DEPARTMENT: Radiology Operations
VERSION: 1.8
OVERVIEW: This comprehensive operating guide details how hospital personnel should interact with the PACS Viewer module to execute how to troubleshoot high-resolution pacs dicom viewing safely and reliably.
STEPS:
Step 1: Open the PACS Viewer client terminal on any networked SMCH workstation and log in with role credentials.
Step 2: Enter the patient's unique UHID or Case Number to load active records.
Step 3: Access the designated submenu corresponding to How to Troubleshoot High-Resolution PACS DICOM Viewing and verify current patient status.
Step 4: Input all required clinical or administrative parameters, ensuring mandatory fields are validated.
Step 5: Verify preview confirmation modal and click 'Submit' to persist changes to the database.
Step 6: Print barcode, acknowledgement chit, or receipt as required by hospital compliance.
- [ISSUE & FIX] Connection timeout: Verify LAN cable connection or contact IT Helpdesk.
- [ISSUE & FIX] Permission Denied: Ensure user account has the assigned role in staff master permissions.
Contact Radiology Operations coordinator or IT Operations Support at Extension 1033 (Email: it@smch.in).
